reason: The label is short and clean: water, yerba mate, fruit concentrate, no sweeteners or preservatives, 4 g sugar. That is rare in a can, and 54 CZK is nothing for me, so I'd buy one pack to see if it fits my pre-training slot instead of my homemade matcha.
objection: Honestly I can cold-brew mate or whisk matcha at home for a fraction of that, so the can has to taste good enough and be convenient enough to earn a place in my week. One pack, not a habit yet.
would_change_my_mind: If it tastes flat or bitter, or the full ingredient list on the back shows anything beyond what's on the front, I won't reorder or subscribe.
